mapper.select: select scenario_code, title, goal, persona_prompt, level_hint, opening_line, voice, opening_line_low, opening_line_mid, opening_line_high from conversation_scenario where owner_user_id is null and visibility=1 and status=1 and deleted_at is null order by id

select s.id, s.scenario_id, s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.resume_topic_zh, s.resume_topic_en, s.resume_evidence, s.resume_state, (select t.user_text from conversation_turn t join conversation_teaching_reply r on r.turn_id=t.id where t.id=s.resume_source_turn_id and t.session_id=s.id and r.completed=1 and r.practice_input=0 and t.id > COALESCE((select p.context_reset_turn from learner_profile p where p.subject_key=IF(s.user_id is null,CONCAT('device:',s.device_id),CONCAT('user:',s.user_id))),0)) resume_source_text from training_session s where
s.user_id=#{userId} s.device_id=#{deviceId} and s.user_id is null
and s.started_at is not null and exists (select 1 from conversation_turn t where t.session_id=s.id and char_length(trim(t.user_text)) > 0) order by s.started_at desc, s.id desc

select t.session_id, t.user_text, (select a.score from pronunciation_assessment a where a.turn_id=t.id and a.score between 0 and 100 order by a.id desc limit 1) score from conversation_turn t where t.session_id in #{id} and char_length(trim(t.user_text)) > 0 order by t.session_id, t.seq

select i.id, i.opening_topic_zh, i.opening_topic_en from user_practice_plan_item i join user_practice_plan p on p.id=i.plan_id and p.user_id=i.user_id left join conversation_scenario s on s.id=i.scenario_id where i.user_id=#{userId} and i.scheduled_date=#{today} and i.status in (0,1) and p.status=1 and p.deleted_at is null and (p.start_date is null or p.start_date <=#{today}) and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date >=#{today}) and (i.target_count is null or i.done_count < i.target_count) and (i.scenario_id is null or (s.scenario_code=#{scenarioId} and s.status=1 and s.deleted_at is null)) and (nullif(trim(i.opening_topic_zh),'') is not null or nullif(trim(i.opening_topic_en),'') is not null) order by i.seq, i.id limit 1
mapper.update: update training_session set resume_topic_zh=#{zh}, resume_topic_en=#{en}, resume_evidence=#{evidence} where id=#{sessionId}

update training_session s set resume_topic_zh=#{zh},resume_topic_en=#{en},resume_evidence='USER_DEFERRED', resume_source_turn_id=#{turn},resume_state='OPEN' where s.id=#{session} and exists(select 1 from conversation_turn t where t.id=#{turn} and t.session_id=s.id) and (s.resume_source_turn_id is null or s.resume_source_turn_id < #{turn} or (s.resume_source_turn_id=#{turn} and s.resume_state='OPEN'))
mapper.select: select first_introduced_at AS introducedAt,last_avatar_id AS avatarId,last_avatar_name AS avatarName from conversation_opening_encounter where subject_key=#{subject}
mapper.insert: insert into conversation_opening_encounter(subject_key,first_introduced_at,last_session_id,last_avatar_id,last_avatar_name,last_shown_at) values(#{subject},IF(#{intro},#{at},NULL),#{session},#{avatar},#{name},#{at}) on duplicate key update first_introduced_at=COALESCE(first_introduced_at,VALUES(first_introduced_at)), last_session_id=IF(VALUES(last_shown_at)>=last_shown_at,VALUES(last_session_id),last_session_id), last_avatar_id=IF(VALUES(last_shown_at)>=last_shown_at,VALUES(last_avatar_id),last_avatar_id), last_avatar_name=IF(VALUES(last_shown_at)>=last_shown_at,VALUES(last_avatar_name),last_avatar_name), last_shown_at=GREATEST(last_shown_at,VALUES(last_shown_at))
